paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 6.31, with a change of 4.64% from the prior close and a change of -23.14% over a window of 22 sessions.

The recent news about Fermi Inc. includes reports of Cetera Investment Advisers raising its stock position in the company, and the company expecting to sign binding agreements with tenants over the next year. There are also reports of a $375M convertible note deal and its impact on the stock price, as well as comments from Fermi cofounder Toby Neugebauer on market support.

There have been various SEC filings from Fermi Inc., including the appointment of new officers, the resignation of director Miles Everson, and the issuance of $431.25 million in aggregate principal amount of 5.00% convertible senior notes due 2031. There has been one Form 4 filing and no Form 144 filings.
